description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'JmsBasedRequestResponseClient' that implements client-side logic for request-response communication using JMS (Java Message Service). It manages JMS links, message creation, sending requests, handling responses, and processing success or failure scenarios. It serves as a base for specific implementations that handle particular types of request/response results.

classes.name: JmsBasedRequestResponseClient
classes.description: An abstract client class for request-response messaging over JMS, managing message creation, sending, and response handling.

methods.name: createLinks
methods.description: Establishes JMS consumer and producer links for communication.

methods.name: createProducer
methods.description: Creates the JMS message producer.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates the JMS message consumer and sets up message listener for responses.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates an empty JMS BytesMessage, optionally with JSON or binary payload.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a JMS message, associating it with a unique correlation ID and returning a Future for the response.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation or errors during message sending.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Processes incoming response messages based on correlation ID and status.

methods.name: handleSuccess
methods.description: Handles a successful response message, parsing payload and creating result object.

methods.name: handleFailure
methods.description: Handles an error response message.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for interpreting a successful response into the result type.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active.

methods.name: setRequestTimeout
methods.description: Method acknowledging feature support but throws exception as unsupported.

methods.name: getCredit
methods.description: Returns the credit value for flow control; default is 1.

methods.name: sendQueueDrainHandler
methods.description: Unsupported for JMS, throws exception.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Extracts cache directive from message properties.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Extracts status code from message properties.

methods.name: getStringProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a string property from a JMS message.

methods.name: getCorrelationID
methods.description: Retrieves the JMS correlation ID from a message.

methods.name: getMessageID
methods.description: Retrieves the JMS message ID from a message.

methods.name: getServiceInvocationException
methods.description: Converts a JMSException into a specific ServiceInvocationException, parsing error condition if present.
